name: Miyoko
source:
A stoic girl. She is bored most of the time. Because of this, she seeks adventure and thrilling situations. Although, that does not mean she would jump into any dangerous path. She may not look like a fighter, but she is stronger than she looks like. One of her skills is grabbing any object to knock her opponents down. She does not get scared easily, but is not fond of ghosts. History is her worst subject.

[From [url=http://darknights-time.weebly.com/heroine.html]official site[/url]]
